verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's feature docs list speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and hands-free voice and video calls. The voice-and-audio docs add that replies are read aloud sentence by sentence as they stream, and describe a hands-free talk/answer/read-back loop. That covers transcription, spoken replies, and live voice conversation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of transcribing recorded or uploaded voice notes (as opposed to live speech input), in-depth docs for STT provider setup on the core platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported

citations.quote: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls
Responses are read aloud sentence by sentence as they stream, so playback starts before the response finishes.
